dimensions.completeness: Are all relevant test scope dimensions covered? (1=major gaps, 5=all relevant dimensions present)
dimensions.specificity: Are test descriptions concrete and actionable? (1=vague/generic, 5=every item names specific behaviour/flow/condition)
dimensions.risk_calibration: Is the coverage depth (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH) appropriate for change type and risk? (1=wrong, 5=correct)
dimensions.integration_awareness: Does ATSR identify relevant cross-system touchpoints? (1=misses obvious integrations, 5=maps all relevant boundaries)
dimensions.clarification_flag_quality: Are flagged gaps genuinely useful and materially relevant? (1=generic/irrelevant, 5=specific/actionable)

scores.title: Online Ordering Portal Menu Sync Bug
scores.notes: All 5 dimensions covered well. Some regression tests slightly generic. Coverage depth MEDIUM is correct for integration bug fix.

scores.title: Payment Firmware Patch — Quick Chip Reconnection
scores.notes: Excellent: explicitly generated all 6 device/version matrix combinations from sparse input. Integration tests somewhat generic on backend. Clarification flags useful but brief.

scores.title: New Wi-Fi 7 Access Point Hardware Rollout
scores.notes: Strong coverage of all 4 network types and line-busting tablet. Added Wi-Fi 6/7 handoff exploratory test beyond spec. Depth MEDIUM correct.

scores.title: New Catering Voucher Tender Key on POS
scores.notes: Missed specific report type counts (3 financial + 6 analytics reports listed in spec). Regression tests too generic ('test existing tender types'). Integration with reporting pipeline underdeveloped. Strongest HIGH-complexity failure case.

scores.title: New Extra-Large Beverage Size Menu Addition
scores.notes: High specificity: 2x medium pricing, default modifier count of 6, all 3 beverage categories named. Added mobile ordering app integration beyond ground truth.

scores.title: Menu Item Availability App Time Window Enhancement
scores.notes: Excellent: identified daily recurrence, date boundary edge case, backward compatibility, both POS versions. Added daylight saving time edge case beyond spec — high-quality domain reasoning.

scores.title: Role-Based Access Control — Void on Empty Check Restriction
scores.notes: Listed all named roles for both brands. Captured food item replication note from spec. Added audit logging of blocked void attempts beyond ground truth. Clarification flags brief.

scores.title: Delivery Markup Percentage Config Change
scores.notes: Multi-environment testing (UAT/Pre-Prod/Prod) not explicitly recommended despite being in spec. Clarification flag on retroactivity is excellent — matches the key open question in the ground truth.

scores.title: SSL Certificate Renewal for Loyalty Platform
scores.notes: Missed multi-environment progression (UAT→Pre-Prod→Prod) despite being a standard deployment process. Added cert import failure scenario exploratory test. Depth LOW correct.

scores.title: Mobile App Advance Order Price Lock Behavior
scores.notes: Coverage HIGH is debatable for an exploratory edge case validation — MEDIUM may be more accurate. Core price lock scenarios captured. Clarification flags functional but generic.

scores.title: Financial Report Layout Change — Section Reordering
scores.notes: Named specific sections correctly (Tender Media, Group Sales, Discounts, Service Charges). Integration tests generic ('any data feeds'). Flags functional but brief.

scores.title: POS Hierarchy Zone Addition for Non-Traditional Locations
scores.notes: Good zone inheritance testing. Correctly identified limited-menu design exclusion. Exploratory on dual-zone assignment is a strong edge case. Flags somewhat generic.

scores.title: Digital Ordering App Upgrade — Device/OS Matrix Testing
scores.notes: Highest scoring spec. Explicitly covered all 4 device/OS combinations. Added network performance under poor conditions. Clarification flag on pending release notes is critical and highly actionable — you cannot test new features without them.

scores.title: Gift Card Cancel Messaging Bug Fix
scores.notes: Lowest scoring spec. The specific cancel message text was captured verbatim — excellent specificity. But completeness is thin: regression and integration sections are shallow. Only 1 clarification flag despite this being a file-configuration issue that warrants asking about deployment process.

scores.title: BIN Range Regression — Existing Coupons Unaffected
scores.notes: Second lowest score. Did not capture the specific conflict/boundary testing between old and new BIN ranges — which is the most important test. Regression tests are generic ('test a sample'). Coverage MEDIUM is debatable — this is arguably a LOW-risk content records change. Flags are functional but miss the deployment timing concern.

scores.title: Antivirus Exclusion Script Deployment
scores.notes: Solid across all dimensions. Correctly identified that existing exclusions must not be affected. Remote session end-to-end test well-reasoned. Flags on specific labs and terminal models are actionable.

scores.title: POS Crew Notification Feature Enablement
scores.notes: Perfect score. Comprehensive coverage of notification creation, scheduling, clock-in display, multi-workstation sync. Exploratory tests highly specific (simultaneous clock-ins, overlapping notifications, corrupted data). All 3 clarification flags would materially change the test design (storage model, permissions, dismiss/snooze behavior).

scores.title: Secondary DNS Provider Change — Broad System Regression
scores.notes: Correctly mapped all listed system areas. Effort estimate of 50-80 cases shows strong risk awareness. Specificity limited — functional tests say 'Verify DNS resolution for X' rather than naming the actual test scenario. Flags are adequate but somewhat surface-level.
